lines.en: label makotodorm55p1:
I knock on Makoto’s door and wait for her to answer. But, based on just how silent it is behind said door, it’s possible she’s not even home at all.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Makoto 的门，等她回应。但从门后那一片死寂来看，她很可能根本不在家。

lines.en: At the very least, Miku’s definitely not here because I don’t think she’s ever been quiet at any point in her life.
lines.zh: 至少 Miku 肯定不在，因为我觉得她这辈子从没有哪一刻是安静的。

lines.en: : Come in!
lines.zh: : 进来！

lines.en: Well fuck me, I guess.
lines.zh: 好吧，操我的。

lines.en: scene black
I turn the handle and open the door, only to be met by a wave of humid air pushing itself out of the bedroom and into my face.
lines.zh: 我转动把手推开门，迎面撞上一股湿热的空气，从卧室里涌出来糊了我一脸。

lines.en: scene makotomikubras1
But I am gifted with a wonderful sight that makes me immediately forget what I was about to complain about.
lines.zh: 但一个美妙的景象立刻让我忘了自己本来要抱怨什么。

lines.en: : Yo!
: Welcome to nudity.
lines.zh: : 欢迎来到裸体世界。

lines.en: : Am I interrupting something? I knew things were a little too quiet in here, but I didn’t think-
lines.zh: : 我打扰到什么了吗？我就说这儿怎么这么安静，但我没想到——

lines.en: : Sorry to let you down, but no. You weren’t interrupting anything. Miku and I were just reading.
lines.zh: : 抱歉让你失望了，没有。你没打扰到什么。Miku 和我只是在看书。

lines.en: : You really expect me to believe that Miku knows how to read?
lines.zh: : 你真指望我相信 Miku 会看书？

lines.en: scene makotomikubras2
: Tsk, tsk, tsk. I’ll have you know I can read at a fourth grade level, Sensei. Most of the time, at least.
lines.zh: : 啧，啧，啧。我得让你知道，我是有四年级阅读水平的，老师。大部分时候吧。

lines.en: : Why do you look so proud of yourself?
lines.zh: : 你为什么一副很骄傲的样子？

lines.en: : So...do you two always strip down to your underwear while you read? Or is this some new sort of...ritual for you?
lines.zh: : 那么……你俩看书的时候都只穿内衣？还是这是你们某种新的……仪式？

lines.en: scene makotomikubras3
: Since you apparently can’t tell by how disgusting it is in here, our AC unit is busted and we need to wait for it to get fixed.
lines.zh: : 你大概看不出这屋里有多难受吧——我们的空调坏了，得等修。

lines.en: : Methinks Makoto broke it herself as an excuse for fanservice. Either way, don’t matter to me! I thrive in the warmth!
lines.zh: : 我猜是 Makoto 自己弄坏的，好找个借口发福利。反正我不介意！我在温暖里茁壮成长！

lines.en: : And I want to die. But I suppose that’s not really a new development and is only exacerbated by the temperature.
lines.zh: : 而我想死。不过我想这也不算什么新鲜事，只是被温度加剧了而已。

lines.en: : I don’t mind who or what you exacerbate so long as ya do it under the blanket.
lines.zh: : 你们怎么加剧都行，只要在毯子底下。

lines.en: : Help me.
lines.zh: : 救救我。

lines.en: : Sure. Shall we resume this conversation under the blanket?
lines.zh: : 好啊。我们要不要在毯子底下继续这场对话？

lines.en: : As if I’d be able to survive under the blanket when I’m struggling to get by as-is. One more layer would surely spell my demise.
lines.zh: : 我现在这样都快撑不下去了，哪还能在毯子底下活下来。再多一层肯定就是我的死期。

lines.en: : So...it would be fine if you removed a layer?
lines.zh: : 那么……如果你脱掉一层就没问题？

lines.en: : Again, ain’t gonna bother me! That ain’t the most flatterin’ underwear anyway, Makoto. Go ahead and take it off so you two crazy kids can exasperate all over each other.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，我无所谓啦！反正那件内衣也不怎么好看，Makoto。脱吧，好让你们两个疯小孩互相「加剧」。

lines.en: scene makotomikubras4
: First, it was “exacerbate.” Which you were already confusing with “masturbate.” But, more importantly than that, how are you going to talk down on my underwear when you’re wearing that?
lines.zh: : 首先，那个词是「加剧」。而你已经把它跟「自慰」搞混了。不过更重要的是，你自己穿着那身东西，凭什么贬低我的内衣？

lines.en: : Tsk, tsk, tsk. Ya seem to be missin’ the whole point of this get-up, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 啧，啧，啧。你好像没抓住这身打扮的重点啊，Makoto。

lines.en: : What is it with you and these “tsk tsk tsks” today? And yes, I am likely missing the point. Unless the point is that normal bras just don’t fit you yet.
lines.zh: : 你今天怎么老「啧啧啧」？而且对，我大概确实没抓住重点。除非重点是普通胸罩你还穿不了。

lines.en: : That...is partially true! But the truer thingy I was gettin’ at is that sports bras and lil’ tanktop thingies fit gals with this body type better than anythin’! Ain’t that right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那……只对了一半！我真正想说的是：运动胸罩和小背心那种东西，比任何东西都更适合咱们这种体型的姑娘！对吧，老师？

lines.en: : The only way I can know for sure is by physically examining you.
lines.zh: : 我唯一能确定的方法，就是亲自上手检查。

lines.en: scene makotomikubras5
: As you please.
lines.zh: : 随你。

lines.en: : I’m not allowed, am I?
lines.zh: : 我是不被允许的，对吧？

lines.en: : Correct. You are not allowed.
lines.zh: : 正确。你不被允许。

lines.en: : Sorry, Miku. Maybe next time.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Miku。也许下次吧。

lines.en: scene makotomikubras6
: Fine by me. I was about to leave you two alone anyway. Lots more studyin’ to catch up on since Makoto’s been crackin’ down on me lately.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。我本来也打算留你俩独处。最近 Makoto 对我管得严，我得补好多功课。

lines.en: : But hey, maybe I’ll make it up to fifth grade level by the end of the year! That’d be neat!
lines.zh: : 不过嘿，说不定到年底我能升到五年级水平！那可太棒了！

lines.en: : Works for me. Maybe I could even whisk Makoto away or something since she’s apparently dying in here?
lines.zh: : 我没意见。既然 Makoto 显然快热死在这儿了，也许我可以把她带走什么的？

lines.en: scene makotomikubras7
: Whisk me away to where? The underwear store? You know, since you and Miku apparently hate my bra.
lines.zh: : 带我去哪儿？内衣店？毕竟你和 Miku 显然都讨厌我的胸罩。

lines.en: : Don’t lump me in with her. I think your bra is entirely...adequate.
lines.zh: : 别把我跟她归为一类。我觉得你的胸罩完全……够用。

lines.en: : Wow, how flattering.
lines.zh: : 哇，真会夸人。

lines.en: scene black
Makoto and Miku head back to their beds and I follow the “vibe” of the room by making my way over to Makoto’s as well.
lines.zh: Makoto 和 Miku 回各自床上去了，而我顺着这屋里的「气场」，也往 Makoto 床边走。

lines.en: Now, I know you’re probably wondering what a “vibe” is. And to that, I say...
lines.zh: 现在，我知道你大概在想「气场」是什么。对此我只能说……

lines.en: Same.
lines.zh: 我也不知道。

lines.en: But I’m pretty sure it means a “feeling” and I’m pretty sure the feeling in here is that I’m supposed to be hanging out with Makoto, so yeah.
lines.zh: 但我挺确定它的意思是「一种感觉」，而我挺确定这儿的感觉是我该跟 Makoto 待在一起，所以，就这样。

lines.en: scene makotomikubras8
: Upon closer inspection, I kind of like your underwear.
lines.zh: : 仔细看看，我其实还挺喜欢你的内衣的。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure you just kind of like my ass.
lines.zh: : 我挺确定你只是喜欢我的屁股。

lines.en: : It’s a good ass.
lines.zh: : 那是个好屁股。

lines.en: : What do you want, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你想干嘛，老师？

lines.en: : I want to hang out with my new best friend, Makoto Miyamura. Who is also known as “The girl I’m going to be worryingly nice to from now on.”
lines.zh: : 我想跟我新的最好的朋友宫村 Makoto 待一会儿。她也叫「从现在开始我要对她好到让人担心」的那个女孩。

lines.en: : Any amount of niceties from you is worrying. Which is why I asked you what you want. But if you’re just here to spend time with me and stare at my butt, I guess that’s fine too.
lines.zh: : 你任何一点好意都让人担心。所以我才问你想干嘛。不过如果你只是来陪我、顺便盯着我的屁股看，那也行。

lines.en: : Do you not want to leave? I was ready to head out for an exciting night on the town with you.
lines.zh: : 你不想出去吗？我本来准备带你进城过一个刺激的夜晚。

lines.en: scene makotomikubras9
: To be honest, I kind of want to read my book. Which isn’t me directly saying I want you to leave, but...
lines.zh: : 说实话，我有点想看我的书。这不算直接叫你走，不过……

lines.en: scene makotomikubras10
: If you just so happened to leave right now, I wouldn’t be all that torn up inside.
lines.zh: : 如果你现在就这么走了，我也不会有多伤心。

lines.en: : What happened to the Makoto who used to cling to me like Velcro?
lines.zh: : 那个像魔术贴一样黏着我的 Makoto 去哪儿了？

lines.en: : A lot. Where have you been the last few months?
lines.zh: : 发生了很多事。你这几个月都去哪儿了？

lines.en: : Not spending enough time with you apparently. Which is precisely why I will refuse to leave right now so we can make up for lost time. Your book can wait.
lines.zh: : 显然没花够时间陪你。所以我坚决不走，好把失去的时间补回来。你的书可以等。

lines.en: scene makotomikubras11
: Fine. But only because you’re very rarely this pushy when it comes to me and I think it’s kind of cute to have you doing that instead of pushing back for once.
lines.zh: : 行吧。不过只是因为你很少在我面前这么强势，而且我觉得看你这样、而不是像平时那样顶回来，还挺可爱的。

lines.en: : I can assure you it’s all part of my master plan to shape you into the perfect bride.
lines.zh: : 我向你保证，这都是我把你塑造成完美新娘的宏伟计划的一部分。

lines.en: : Don’t tempt me with a good time, Sensei. Jokes like that don’t always stay jokes forever, you know. You could be unintentionally foreshadowing something right now.
lines.zh: : 别拿好事诱惑我，老师。玩笑并不永远是玩笑，你知道的。你现在可能正在无意中埋下伏笔。

lines.en: : At the same time, not all dialogue has to be foreshadowing- but I suppose we can leave that at that for now.
lines.zh: : 同时，也不是所有对话都得是伏笔——不过我想这个话题先到这儿吧。

lines.en: : What would you like to discuss instead? I think I’m all drama’ed out for the time being. Plus, Miku is right across the room, so we can’t exactly talk about her again.
lines.zh: : 那你想聊点什么？我暂时演够了。而且 Miku 就在房间另一头，所以我们没法再聊她。

lines.en: : Huh? You two were talkin’ about me? When?
lines.zh: : 哈？你俩在聊我？什么时候？

lines.en: scene makotomikubras12
: Whenever the last time you lied to me was.
lines.zh: : 上一次你骗我的时候。

lines.en: : I ain’t got any idea what yer talkin’ about, so...I’m just gonna keep on reading.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道你们在说什么，所以……我就继续看书了。

lines.en: : Subtle.
lines.zh: : 真含蓄。

lines.en: scene makotomikubras13
: For now. I’m keeping an eye out.
lines.zh: : 暂时吧。我盯着呢。

lines.en: : Well, since you’re all drama’ed out and Miku is out of the discussion, I guess...you can tell me about your day?
lines.zh: : 嗯，既然你演够了、Miku 又不能聊，那我想……你可以跟我说说你今天过得怎么样？

lines.en: scene makotomikubras14
: Ew. Can you start a little slower if you’re going to be nice from now on? Acting so uncharacteristic right off the bat is throwing me off.
lines.zh: : 恶。你要从现在开始对我好的话，能不能慢慢来？一上来就这么反常，我很不适应。

lines.en: : I’m bad at being casual and friendly and all of my regular conversation topics are either all about me or just way too sexual to maintain without throwing myself on top of you.
lines.zh: : 我不擅长随和友善，而我平时所有的话题不是全关于我自己，就是太色情——不扑到你身上就维持不下去。

lines.en: : Under the blanket’s okay! Just wanna remind ya!
lines.zh: : 毯子底下就行！就是提醒一下！

lines.en: : Thanks, Miku. Appreciated.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Miku。感激不尽。

lines.en: scene makotomikubras15
: Standard small talk it is then, but...how even was my day?
lines.zh: : 那就标准的闲聊吧，不过……我今天过得怎么样来着？

lines.en: : It feels like it kind of ended without anything interesting happening.
lines.zh: : 感觉这一天就这么结束了，什么有意思的事都没发生。

lines.en: : The day itself was fine...I helped Miss Imai reorganize all of the desks after class...Then I helped her clean the locker room....Then I helped her mop the pool room...And I think that was it.
lines.zh: : 这一天本身还行……课后我帮今井老师把所有课桌重新摆了一遍……然后帮她打扫了更衣室……然后帮她拖了泳池房的地……我想就这些了。

lines.en: : Well here’s hoping you don’t fall for her next, I guess. Having someone else steal away my one and only teacher’s pet sounds like something I don’t want to deal with.
lines.zh: : 那我希望你下一个别栽在她身上。让我唯一一个老师的宠物被别人抢走，听起来是我不太想应付的事。

lines.en: : You’re only saying that because I do all of your work for you.
lines.zh: : 你这么说只是因为我替你把所有活都干了。

lines.en: : There are other benefits as well. I just can’t talk about them until we’re underneath the blanket.
lines.zh: : 还有别的好处。只是那些得等我们到毯子底下才能说。

lines.en: : Oh, and there was something with Yumi as well. I completely forgot, but she actually asked me for help with something earlier. Math, I think.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有 Yumi 的事。我完全忘了，她今天早些时候还找我帮了个忙。数学，我想。

lines.en: : Hey, there’s a conversation topic. What’s going on with you and Yumi?
lines.zh: : 嘿，这是个话题。你和 Yumi 怎么回事？

lines.en: scene makotomikubras16
: Uhh...nothing? I just helped her with some equation. It’s not like we’re going to the Spring Fling together. Especially on account of spring literally not existing here.
lines.zh: : 呃……没什么？我就帮她解了道方程。我们又不是要一起去春季舞会。更别说这儿压根就不存在春天。

lines.en: : I’m talking more about how you helped get her suspension revoked. Why?
lines.zh: : 我说的更多是你帮她把停学处分撤销的事。为什么？

lines.en: : What do you mean why? What kind of future-teacher would I be if I just let someone who needs help get kicked out of school? That goes against everything I stand for.
lines.zh: : 什么意思，为什么？如果一个需要帮助的人被赶出学校我却袖手旁观，那我还算什么未来的老师？那违背我所信奉的一切。

lines.en: : So...it wasn’t just because you wanted to get revenge on Nodoka for-
lines.zh: : 所以……不只是因为你想报复 Nodoka，为——

lines.en: : Please do not bring up my embarrassing defeat in the first Dorm Wars. Especially in a way that makes it sound like I would wish bodily harm upon her for just outsmarting me.
lines.zh: : 请别提我在第一次宿舍大战里那丢人的失败。尤其别用那种听起来像我会因为她只是比我聪明就希望她身体受伤害的说法。

lines.en: scene makotomikubras17
: Though, it would be nice if she’d leave me alone in the shower...
lines.zh: : 不过，她要是能让我一个人洗澡就好了……

lines.en: : I really wish you guys would invite me in there one day. It’s one of the only places I haven’t gone yet.
lines.zh: : 我真希望你们哪天能邀请我进去。那是我还没去过的地方之一。

lines.en: : Here’s hoping it remains that way. But anyway, the point is that I just didn’t think it was fair to indefinitely suspend her.
lines.zh: : 但愿它一直是。总之，重点是我只是觉得无限期停她课不公平。

lines.en: : I think that if a student wants to learn, she or he should be given the tools to do so. And Yumi wouldn’t have come back if she didn’t want to. I just made it a little easier for her to do that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得如果一个学生想学，就该给她／他学习的工具。而 Yumi 如果不想回来，她是不会回来的。我只是让她回来得容易了一点。

lines.en: : Well, thank you for once again going out of your way to help someone who is both resistant to help and doesn’t deserve it.
lines.zh: : 好吧，谢谢你又一次不辞辛劳地去帮一个既抗拒帮助、又不配得到帮助的人。

lines.en: scene makotomikubras18
: What can I say? That sort of thing is becoming a bit of a specialty to me.
lines.zh: : 我能说什么呢？这种事快成我的专长了。

lines.en: : Why are you taking so much interest in this, though? You seemed pretty indifferent around the time I brought it up.
lines.zh: : 可你为什么对这事这么上心？我提起来那会儿你看起来挺无所谓的。

lines.en: : Yeah, but that’s probably because I was in the middle of trying to reset the world and that it wasn’t something I was entirely conscious for.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过那大概是因为我当时正忙着重置世界，而且这事我并不是完全清醒地经历的。

lines.en: scene makotomikubras19
: If you’re quoting something right now, I don’t get the reference. I don’t really watch TV.
lines.zh: : 如果你在引用什么，我没看懂。我不怎么看电视。

lines.en: : Don’t mind me. Just talking about how the world is part of a never-ending cycle and that we’re doomed to relive this school year over and over and over again for the rest of our lives.
lines.zh: : 别管我。只是在说这个世界是一个永无止境的循环的一部分，我们注定要把这个学年一遍又一遍地重活下去，直到永远。

lines.en: : Again, not getting the reference. But I don’t think I’d mind having you as my teacher for the rest of eternity.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，没看懂引用。但我不介意让你当我永远的老师。

lines.en: : And I’m not just saying that because you singlehandedly prevent me from ever having to exacerbate.
lines.zh: : 而且我这么说，不只是因为你一个人就让我永远不用「加剧」。

lines.en: : Well, I’m glad this relationship is mutually beneficial for the both of us. It’s just one more thing for me to look forward to as my apocalypse counter begins to tick upward.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我很高兴这段关系对我们俩是互利的。这只是我末日计数器开始往上走时，又一件值得期待的事。

lines.en: scene makotomikubras20
: I didn’t realize you believed in that sort of thing, Sensei. Though, just to clarify, you are talking about the apocalypse in a more biblical sense, correct? Not a natural one?
lines.zh: : 我不知道你还信这个，老师。不过确认一下，你说的末日是更偏向《圣经》意义上的，对吧？不是自然意义上的？

lines.en: : Correct. There’s no way a natural phenomenon could possibly explain how-
lines.zh: : 正确。自然现象不可能解释得通——

lines.en: : Wait...why aren’t you changing the subject?
lines.zh: : 等等……你为什么不换话题？

lines.en: scene makotomikubras21
: Because...I’m polite? And actually capable of carrying on a normal conversation when the person I’m talking to isn’t busy shoving his hands down my pants?
lines.zh: : 因为……我有礼貌？而且当跟我说话的人没忙着把手伸进我裤子里时，我确实能进行一场正常对话？

lines.en: : No, I just mean that...uhh...extenuating circumstances prevent anyone else from ever being able to talk about this without immediately changing the topic.
lines.zh: : 不，我只是说……呃……有些特殊状况，让其他任何人一谈到这个就会立刻换话题。

lines.en: : Sensei, I’m only saying this because I’m allowed to be mean to you now...but what the fuck are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 老师，我现在说这个只是因为我被允许对你凶了……可你他妈到底在说什么？

lines.en: : I’m talking about how this shouldn’t be possible with anyone other than Maya and Ayane...and yet here you are, perfectly navigating the talk as if it’s something you’ve known all along.
lines.zh: : 我说的是，这种事本来只有 Maya 和 Ayane 能做到……可你却在这儿，完美地接着话题往下走，好像你一直都知道似的。

lines.en: scene makotomikubras22
: Known what? Why are you being so weird?
lines.zh: : 知道什么？你怎么这么怪？

lines.en: : Because this is what happens anytime I talk about this with anyone else. Watch.
lines.zh: : 因为这就是我跟别人谈起这事时每次都会发生的。看着。

lines.en: : Miku.
lines.zh: : Miku。

lines.en: scene makotomikubras23
: Hm? Yeah?
lines.zh: : 嗯？干嘛？

lines.en: : Every few months, the world starts over and everyone-
lines.zh: : 每隔几个月，世界就会重启，所有人——

lines.en: scene makotomikubras24
: Oh! Sensei! I forgot to tell ya about this crazy thing that happened at swim practice the other day! Ya have a sec? Or are you still too busy kickin’ it with my best friendo?
lines.zh: : 哦！老师！我忘了跟你说前两天游泳训练时发生的一件超疯的事！你有空吗？还是你还在忙着跟我最好的朋友腻在一起？

lines.en: : See? She immediately changed the topic.
lines.zh: : 看到了吧？她立刻换了话题。

lines.en: : This is Miku we’re talking about. She can’t stay focused on anything.
lines.zh: : 我们说的是 Miku。她本来就什么事都专注不了。

lines.en: : You try then. See what happens.
lines.zh: : 那你自己试试。看看会怎样。

lines.en: scene makotomikubras25
: Miku, what-
lines.zh: : Miku，什么——

lines.en: : Oh! You and me should go bra shoppin’ soon, Makoto! We can get ya somethin’ that looks like it hasn’t been through the wash eight thousand times.
lines.zh: : 哦！你和我该早点去逛内衣店，Makoto！我们可以给你买件看起来没被洗过八千遍的。

lines.en: : Shut up and listen to me for a second, okay?
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，听我说一秒，好吗？

lines.en: : Okay! Sure!
lines.zh: : 好！当然！

lines.en: : Sensei thinks that the world is-
lines.zh: : 老师觉得这个世界是——

lines.en: : Oh! You and me should go bra shoppin’ soon, Makoto! We can get ya somethin’ that looks like it hasn’t been through the wash eight thousand times.
lines.zh: : 哦！你和我该早点去逛内衣店，Makoto！我们可以给你买件看起来没被洗过八千遍的。

lines.en: scene makotomikubras26
: ...what?
scene makotomikubras27
: See what I mean?
lines.zh: : 明白我意思了吧？

lines.en: : You two are...playing some weird kind of prank on me, right?
lines.zh: : 你俩……在跟我玩某种恶作剧，对吧？

lines.en: : Miku-
lines.zh: : Miku——

lines.en: : Oh! Sensei! I forgot to tell ya about this crazy thing that happened at swim practice the other day! Ya have a sec? Or are you still too busy kickin’ it with my best friendo?
lines.zh: : 哦！老师！我忘了跟你说前两天游泳训练时发生的一件超疯的事！你有空吗？还是你还在忙着跟我最好的朋友腻在一起？

lines.en: : Oh! You and me should go bra shoppin’ soon, Makoto! We can get ya somethin’ that looks like it hasn’t been through the wash eight thousand times.
lines.zh: : 哦！你和我该早点去逛内衣店，Makoto！我们可以给你买件看起来没被洗过八千遍的。

lines.en: scene makotomikubras28
: I don’t get it...why won’t she let us get our thoughts out?
lines.zh: : 我不懂……她为什么不让我们把话说完？

lines.en: : I don’t get it either. But it’s not just her. It’s everyone except you and the two girls I mentioned earlier.
lines.zh: : 我也不懂。而且不只是她。除了你和那两个我提到过的女孩，所有人都这样。

lines.en: : And, for a brief moment in time, Yumi and Tsuneyo as well.
lines.zh: : 还有，有那么一小段时间，Yumi 和 Tsuneyo 也行。

lines.en: : The reason I don’t remember you bringing up whatever it was you did to get Yumi back into school is because I was never there for it.
lines.zh: : 我不记得你提过你为了把 Yumi 弄回学校做了什么，是因为我根本没在场。

lines.en: : You were, though. I saw you. We...We talked and everything.
lines.zh: : 你在场的啊。我看见你了。我们……我们还说了话什么的。

lines.en: : Then why don’t I remember any of it?
lines.zh: : 那我为什么一点都不记得？

lines.en: scene makotomikubras29
: Because...your memories are bad. They’ve been bad every single year since we’ve started-
lines.zh: : 因为……你的记忆有问题。从我们开始以来，每一年都有问题——

lines.en: scene makotomikubras30
: But...wait...I’m a freshman...how have we...
lines.zh: : 可是……等等……我是新生……我们怎么……

lines.en: : Am I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene black
: I have to make a phone call.
lines.zh: : 我得打个电话。

lines.en: : You might want to get dressed.
lines.zh: : 你也许该把衣服穿上。

lines.en: $ makotodorm55p1 = True
$ makoto_love += 1
jump makotodorm55p2
